mobbin:8faed082-5416-4324-b104-7056f0993.summary: From the More screen the user opens Communicate, is asked to enable Household Drop In as an intercom, then lands on Communication with separate Drop In and Announce targets.
steps: More screen with a large Communicate tile
Enable Household Drop In: Later or Enable
Communication with Drop In and Announce
steal: 'Drop In' and 'Announce' are separate top actions (screen 3), so live room intercom and one-way broadcast are not the same control.
An Enable prompt with 'Later' and 'Enable' asks for opt-in before the phone can drop into rooms or devices (screen 2).
The prompt promises 'See recently active devices' (screen 2), so you can see which rooms are alive before connecting.
A large Communicate tile sits among peer jobs on More (screen 1), so gloved or one-hand use is easier.
avoid: A promo banner on the Communication screen (screen 3) competes with the Drop In and Announce targets.
mobbin:8faed082-5416-4324-b104-7056f0993.fit: Mobile and iPad app: the phone beats the SRV as an intercom into a sim room. Separate Drop In (live) versus Announce (broadcast) would extend the baseline intercom mic idea. This is not a desktop-only job.
